body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 53c9072f0117c240b6e020563c34b633e0d92a09 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good:
- The draft-only pattern is sound. The Vc and fz edits write the window's draft only; the editor's one Apply lands them as one `ChangeTool`, one undo step. A test proves it (`an_fz_or_vc_edit_sets_the_stored_feed_or_rpm_and_is_one_undo_step`).
- The refused inputs fail by name. A missing flute count or a zero rpm refuses the chip load input; a zero diameter refuses the surface speed input. The disabled input names the reason on hover. The conversion functions (`rpm_for`, `feed_for`) return the reason as an error too, so nothing divides by zero. A refusal test proves both refusals and that a refused input changes nothing.
- The inch lens converts both ways with unit tests (`the_inch_lens_converts_both_ways`) and a UI test covers the mm lens.
- No new `camcraft-*` dependency, no new command, no new test binary (the new test file is a module of the existing `camcraft-ui` lib test suite), no snapshot PNG changes, no process files. The decision file `docs/decisions/4453-recipe-fz-vc-inputs.md` records what was decided, why, what was dropped, the frame cost and the cost to change later.
- The stored values and the project file do not change. The derived line is now the hover text of the two inputs.

Results merged with main (on the self-hosted runner, merged with main `b6089ea6e82c0bc47ebb6cf7343b5956684e1126`, trial merge clean):
- Runner run: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/46080088266 (head 53c9072f0117c240b6e020563c34b633e0d92a09; "The head is the one the reviewer read" passed, trial merge clean, clippy clean)
- Quick gate: 11 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, wall 6.4 min. `ui suites: lib` ok (177s; it holds the pinning tests). No site tests in this run (zola/node missing on the runner - SKIP, not a pass, not a blocker).
- Clippy `-p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Targeted tests:
- No post or toolpath change. The example catalog suites are not owed.
- Light lane: not run in this session. `cargo xtask gate light` (release mode, camcraft-motion and camcraft-app) was still building when it was stopped; it did not complete. The quick gate on the merged tree is green. Per the rules a red light run is a note on the PR, not a blocker - and this is not even red, just not run.
- No P1 targeted heavy step: this is a UI enhancement (P6), not work under the safety floor.

Requested before merge: nothing.

Questions / notes (not blocking):
- The body says the new mod line is "sorted". The lib-test mod list is grouped by feature, not sorted alphabetically. Cosmetic; no tool depends on the order.
- The PR body says "The `crates/ui` test count goes from 2009 to 2015". A note, not a blocker: the runner runs the lib suite green, which is what matters.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
